brief:
Pacific Islanders in Fiji, Samoa and other island nations are mounting opposition to evangelical Zionism within their communities, Middle East Eye reported. The movement reflects growing activism among residents who view Christian Zionist ideology as incompatible with their own positions on Palestine.

Figures including Mara Mahoney and Michel Mulipola are leading efforts to counter deep-rooted Zionist evangelical teachings that have long shaped religious discourse across the region. Their activism represents an emerging challenge to theological frameworks that have historically dominated certain church circles in the Pacific.

title: Pacific Islanders challenge Christian Zionism in their communities
